🧴 Body care is skincare too.
But it is not only body lotion.
At Adilsons Beauty, we see Body Care as head-to-toe routine support.
That means care for:
✅ Body skin
✅ Hands
✅ Feet
✅ Scalp
✅ Hair lengths
✅ Hair styling
✅ Hair colour / hair makeup
✅ Nails
But because this collection is wide, the first question should not be:
“What body care product should I buy?”
The better question is:
👉 Which area are we helping?
Body skin?
Hands?
Feet?
Scalp?
Hair lengths?
Hair styling?
Nails?
Once the area is clear, choosing the right product becomes easier.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌿 What is Body Care?
Body Care is skincare beyond the face.
Your body also deals with:
☀️ Sun exposure
🌧️ Humidity
💦 Sweat
🧴 Sunscreen
👕 Friction from clothing
❄️ Air-conditioning
🧼 Frequent showers
🧴 Dryness
🦶 Rough feet
🖐️ Dry hands
💇‍♀️ Hair frizz
🌴 Mauritius heat
🏖️ Beach and outdoor lifestyle
So body care is not luxury.
It is routine care.
It helps the body, hair, hands, feet, and nails feel cleaner, softer, fresher, smoother-looking, and more comfortable.
But it should not be overpromised.
Body products should not be sold as medical treatment.
Hair products should not be sold as hair-loss cures.
Nail products should not be sold as fungal treatments.
Foot products should not replace medical care for painful, infected-looking, cracked, or diabetic foot concerns.
The simple rule is:
👉 Use Body Care for comfort, freshness, softness, appearance support, and routine consistency — not miracle transformation.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧼 BODY CLEANSER
Body cleanser is for shower cleansing.
This includes body wash, shower gel, soothing body cleanser, brightening-support body wash, acne-prone body cleanser, or exfoliating-style body cleanser.
Use body cleanser for:
✅ Daily shower freshness
✅ Sweat
✅ Body sunscreen removal
✅ Humid-weather cleansing
✅ Back and chest cleansing
✅ Body odour freshness
✅ Skin that feels sticky after heat
✅ Skin that feels heavy after outdoor days
In Mauritius, body cleanser matters because we deal with heat, sweat, sunscreen, dust, humidity, and frequent showers.
But body cleanser should still be gentle enough for regular use.
A body wash should leave the skin feeling clean — not painfully tight.
If the body cleanser has acids, exfoliating ingredients, or acne-prone support positioning, use it carefully.
Do not scrub inflamed body pimples.
Do not use strong active body wash aggressively every day from the start.
Do not skip moisturizer if the skin feels dry after.
Fresh is good.
Stripped is not.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧴 BODY MOISTURIZER
Body moisturizer is the step after showering.
This includes body lotion, body cream, body milk, body gel, brightening-support lotion, soothing body moisturizer, or richer body cream.
Use body moisturizer for:
✅ Dry body skin
✅ Rough elbows
✅ Rough knees
✅ Dry legs
✅ Dry arms
✅ AC dryness
✅ After-shower softness
✅ Body glow routines
✅ More comfortable body skin
✅ More even-looking body tone support
Many people moisturize the face but forget the body.
But the body also gets dry.
The body also gets rough.
The body also needs routine care.
A simple body routine:
1️⃣ Shower with body cleanser
2️⃣ Pat skin dry, but do not over-dry
3️⃣ Apply body moisturizer while skin is still slightly damp
4️⃣ Use richer cream at night if needed
5️⃣ Use SPF on exposed areas during the day
Body moisturizer should help skin feel softer, smoother, and more comfortable.
But do not expect body lotion to permanently whiten skin.
Do not promise tan removal.
Do not scrub dark knees, elbows, neck, or body marks aggressively.
A safer promise is:
✨ Supports softer-feeling body skin
✨ Supports smoother-looking body skin
✨ Supports more even-looking body tone
✨ Supports hydrated and comfortable body skin
That is honest and useful.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ BODY BRIGHTENING SUPPORT
If your goal is body brightening, the answer is not harsh scrubbing.
The safer routine is:
🧼 Gentle body cleanser
🧴 Brightening-support body lotion
☀️ SPF on exposed areas
⏳ Patience
🚫 No aggressive friction
Body skin can take time.
Dark knees, elbows, body marks, neck unevenness, arm marks, or sun-exposed areas usually do not change overnight.
Also, if sun exposure continues without SPF, body brightening routines become weaker.
So the safer body brightening rule is:
👉 Support gently. Moisturize consistently. Protect exposed areas from sun.
Do not chase unsafe whitening.
Do not rub the skin raw.
Do not expect instant transformation.
Healthy-looking, more even-looking body skin takes time.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌿 BODY BLEMISH-PRONE ROUTINES
Body blemishes can happen on the back, chest, shoulders, arms, or other areas.
This can be linked with:
💦 Sweat
🧴 Sunscreen
👕 Tight clothing
🏃 Gym or sports
🌴 Heat and humidity
🧼 Product buildup
🛏️ Friction
🧴 Heavy body products
A body cleanser may support acne-prone body routines.
But be careful with claims.
A body wash should not be sold as an acne cure.
A safer routine:
1️⃣ Cleanse gently in the shower
2️⃣ Use active body cleanser only if suitable
3️⃣ Do not scrub inflamed pimples
4️⃣ Moisturize if skin feels dry
5️⃣ Wear breathable clothing where possible
6️⃣ Seek proper advice if acne is painful, cystic, infected-looking, or scarring
Do not punish body skin.
Support it.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🖐️ HAND CARE
Hands are used all day.
They deal with:
🧼 Handwashing
🧴 Sanitizer
🧽 Cleaning
❄️ Air-conditioning
☀️ Sun exposure
💦 Water
🧴 Dryness around fingers
🌿 Dry cuticle area
Hand cream is simple but useful.
Use hand cream:
✅ After washing hands
✅ Before bed
✅ When hands feel dry
✅ Around cuticles
✅ After sanitizer if skin feels tight
✅ During AC exposure
✅ When hands look dry or rough
Hand care does not need to be complicated.
A hand cream helps hands feel softer and more comfortable.
But if hands are cracked, bleeding, swollen, infected-looking, or painful, skincare may not be enough.
Take the safer path and seek proper advice.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🦶 FOOT CARE
Feet are often ignored until they become uncomfortable.
In Mauritius, foot care matters because of:
🩴 Sandals
🚶 Walking
☀️ Heat
💦 Sweat
🦶 Dry heels
🏖️ Outdoor lifestyle
👟 Shoes and friction
🧼 Frequent washing
Foot care can include foot cream, foot treatment, urea foot cream, heel-care products, and foot peeling masks.
Use foot cream for:
✅ Rough-feeling heels
✅ Dry feet
✅ Sandal-season care
✅ Night foot routine
✅ Feet that feel uncomfortable
✅ Dry-looking soles
A simple foot routine:
1️⃣ Wash feet
2️⃣ Dry properly
3️⃣ Apply foot cream at night
4️⃣ Use socks if comfortable
5️⃣ Repeat consistently
Urea-style foot cream can be useful for rough-feeling heels if the skin is not broken.
Foot peeling masks can be useful for rough feet, but only when feet are intact.
Do not use foot peeling masks on:
❌ Cracked feet
❌ Bleeding feet
❌ Painful areas
❌ Open wounds
❌ Infected-looking skin
❌ Diabetic foot concerns without professional advice
Also, do not peel skin by force.
Let the process happen according to product instructions.
Foot care should support comfort.
Not create injury.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💇‍♀️ HAIR CARE STARTS WITH THE SCALP
Hair care is not one product.
A good hair routine separates:
🧠 Scalp
💇‍♀️ Hair lengths
💧 Dry ends
🌫️ Frizz
✨ Shine
🎀 Styling
🎨 Hair makeup
This is important because shampoo, conditioner, treatment, oil, essence, styling product, and hair makeup all have different jobs.
The simple rule:
👉 Shampoo is mainly for the scalp.
👉 Conditioner is mainly for lengths and ends.
👉 Treatment is deeper support.
👉 Hair oil and essence are finishing or targeted steps.
👉 Styling products shape the look.
👉 Hair makeup is cosmetic, not treatment.
Do not treat every hair concern with one product.
Scalp and hair lengths need different care.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧴 SHAMPOO
Shampoo cleans the scalp.
Not just the hair.
It can help with:
✅ Oily scalp
✅ Sweaty scalp
✅ Product buildup
✅ Scalp freshness
✅ Humid-weather scalp care
✅ Hair wash routine
✅ Post-gym cleansing
✅ Styling-product removal
In Mauritius humidity, many people feel the scalp gets oily or heavy faster.
So shampoo should be chosen based on scalp need.
Ask:
👉 Is the scalp oily?
👉 Is the scalp dry-feeling?
👉 Is there buildup?
👉 Is the scalp sweaty often?
👉 Is the hair damaged-looking but scalp oily?
👉 Is the person using styling products?
Be careful with claims.
Shampoo should not be presented as curing hair loss, psoriasis, infection, seborrheic dermatitis, or alopecia.
Safer wording:
✅ Supports scalp freshness
✅ Helps hair feel cleaner
✅ Supports stronger-looking hair
✅ Suitable for oily-scalp routines
✅ Supports scalp-care routines
If there is severe scalp pain, bleeding, pus, severe scaling, infected-looking areas, or intense irritation, professional advice is safer.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧴 CONDITIONER
Conditioner softens the hair lengths and ends.
It is usually not meant to be applied heavily on an oily scalp.
Use conditioner for:
✅ Dry ends
✅ Frizz
✅ Tangles
✅ Rough-feeling hair
✅ Long hair
✅ Post-shampoo softness
✅ Chemically treated hair
✅ Hair that feels hard to comb
A simple hair-wash routine:
1️⃣ Shampoo the scalp
2️⃣ Rinse
3️⃣ Apply conditioner to lengths and ends
4️⃣ Avoid heavy application on oily scalp
5️⃣ Rinse
6️⃣ Use leave-on oil or essence if needed
Shampoo cleans.
Conditioner softens.
If your scalp gets oily fast, do not overload it with conditioner.
Focus on the hair lengths.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌙 HAIR TREATMENT
Hair treatment is a deeper-care step.
This can include hair masks, treatment packs, protein-style treatments, repair-feel masks, scalp treatments, or intensive rinse-off care.
Use hair treatment for:
✅ Dry hair
✅ Damaged-looking hair
✅ Rough-feeling hair
✅ Frizzy hair
✅ Bleached hair
✅ Heat-styled hair
✅ Chemically treated hair
✅ Hair that lacks softness
✅ Hair that tangles easily
A hair treatment can help hair feel:
✨ Softer
✨ Smoother
✨ Shinier
✨ More manageable
✨ Less rough-feeling
✨ Easier to comb
But do not overpromise.
Hair treatment does not permanently repair destroyed hair structure.
If ends are severely damaged, trimming may still be needed.
A treatment can improve feel, slip, shine, and manageability.
But it cannot undo everything instantly.
A simple rule:
👉 Use hair treatment weekly or as needed for hair that feels dry, rough, or damaged-looking.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🫒 HAIR OIL & ESSENCE
Hair oil and essence are usually finishing or targeted steps.
They can help with:
✅ Frizz
✅ Shine
✅ Dry ends
✅ Smoother-looking hair
✅ Softer hair feel
✅ Post-wash finishing
✅ Flyaways
✅ Hair that looks dull
Use a small amount.
Start with less.
Apply mainly to lengths and ends.
Be careful using hair oil on the scalp if the scalp is already oily.
Too much oil can make fine hair flat.
Too much oil on oily scalp can make the scalp feel heavier.
Hair oil is not for every scalp.
Hair oil is usually best where dryness or frizz appears.
A simple rule:
👉 Use oil or essence where the hair needs shine, softness, or frizz support — not everywhere automatically.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎀 HAIR STYLING
Hair styling products are for the final look.
They can support:
✅ Sleek hair
✅ Frizz control
✅ Curl definition
✅ Hold
✅ Flyaway control
✅ Volume
✅ Heat-style finishing
✅ Event styling
But styling products can build up.
Especially in humidity.
If the hair or scalp feels heavy, sticky, itchy-feeling, or coated, cleansing may need attention.
A styling product is not scalp treatment.
It helps the hair look the way you want.
But it should be washed out properly.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎨 HAIR MAKEUP
Hair makeup is temporary cosmetic hair colour, touch-up, or decorative hair product.
Use hair makeup for:
✅ Temporary colour
✅ Event looks
✅ Creative styling
✅ Quick hair expression
✅ Fun cosmetic finish
But hair makeup is not hair treatment.
It does not repair hair.
It does not treat scalp conditions.
It should not be used on irritated, broken, painful, or infected-looking scalp.
Patch test if needed.
Use according to instructions.
Remove properly.
Hair makeup is for appearance.
Not medical scalp care.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💅 NAIL CARE
Nail care supports nail appearance and grooming.
It may help with:
✅ Clean-looking nails
✅ Cosmetic finish
✅ Nail grooming
✅ Nail maintenance
✅ Hand and foot beauty routines
✅ Polished appearance
But nail care should not be sold as medical treatment.
Do not use cosmetic nail products to claim treatment for:
❌ Nail fungus
❌ Nail infection
❌ Nail lifting
❌ Pus
❌ Pain
❌ Swelling
❌ Thick yellow or green nails
❌ Strange spreading colour changes
If the nail is painful, infected-looking, lifting, or changing colour strangely, professional advice is safer.
A cosmetic nail product supports appearance.
It does not replace proper care for medical-looking nail concerns.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌴 Body Care in Mauritius
Body Care should be adapted to our local reality.
In Mauritius, the body deals with:
☀️ Sun
🌧️ Humidity
💦 Sweat
🧴 Sunscreen
❄️ Air-conditioning
🏖️ Beach/outdoor lifestyle
🩴 Sandals
🧼 Frequent showers
👕 Friction from clothing
💇‍♀️ Frizz from humidity
🧴 Oily scalp
🦶 Dry heels
🖐️ Dry hands from washing
So the product choice should be practical.
For body skin:
Use lighter lotion or gel if heavy creams feel sticky.
Use richer cream at night if skin is dry.
Use SPF on exposed areas if working on body tone.
For scalp:
Choose shampoo by scalp need, not just hair length.
A person can have oily scalp and dry ends.
For hair lengths:
Use conditioner, treatment, oil, or essence where the hair feels dry or frizzy.
For feet:
Use foot cream at night.
Do not wait until heels are painful.
For hands:
Use hand cream after washing or sanitizer.
For nails:
Keep claims cosmetic and safe.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧭 Simple Body Care routine
If you want a simple body routine, start here:
🚿 Shower
Use body cleanser.
🧴 Moisturize
Apply body lotion or cream after showering.
🖐️ Hands
Use hand cream after washing hands.
🦶 Feet
Use foot cream at night if heels feel rough.
☀️ Exposed areas
Use SPF on arms, neck, feet, hands, or other exposed areas when needed.
Simple.
Consistent.
Not harsh.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ Body brightening-support routine
If your goal is brighter-looking or more even-looking body skin:
1️⃣ Use gentle body cleanser
2️⃣ Use brightening-support body lotion
3️⃣ Moisturize consistently
4️⃣ Use SPF on exposed areas
5️⃣ Avoid harsh scrubbing
6️⃣ Be patient
Do not chase unsafe whitening.
Do not expect body marks to disappear overnight.
Do not scrub dark areas aggressively.
The goal is healthier-looking, smoother-looking, more even-looking body skin over time.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌿 Body blemish-prone routine
If the back, chest, or shoulders are blemish-prone:
1️⃣ Cleanse gently
2️⃣ Use active body cleanser only if suitable
3️⃣ Do not scrub inflamed pimples
4️⃣ Shower after heavy sweat when possible
5️⃣ Avoid very tight friction-heavy clothing when possible
6️⃣ Moisturize if skin feels dry
7️⃣ Seek professional advice if painful, cystic, infected-looking, or scarring
Do not treat body blemishes by attacking the skin.
Gentle consistency is safer.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💇‍♀️ Simple hair routine
A simple hair routine:
1️⃣ Shampoo the scalp
2️⃣ Condition the lengths and ends
3️⃣ Use hair treatment weekly if hair feels dry or damaged-looking
4️⃣ Use hair oil or essence on ends if needed
5️⃣ Use styling product only when needed
6️⃣ Cleanse properly to remove buildup
Do not put every product on the scalp.
Do not shampoo the ends aggressively.
Do not overload fine hair with oil.
Do not expect one hair mask to permanently repair everything.
Hair care is routine support.
Not instant reconstruction.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🖐️🦶 Hand and foot routine
Hands and feet need small consistent steps.
For hands:
🖐️ Use hand cream after washing
🖐️ Use before bed
🖐️ Apply around dry areas
🖐️ Avoid harsh products if skin is cracked
For feet:
🦶 Use foot cream at night
🦶 Use urea-style cream for rough-feeling heels if skin is intact
🦶 Use foot peeling mask only as directed
🦶 Avoid peeling masks on cracked, painful, bleeding, or infected-looking feet
This is practical skincare.
Not luxury.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚠️ When to avoid cosmetic-only advice
Sometimes skincare is not enough.
Seek proper guidance if there is:
⚠️ Severe body acne
⚠️ Painful cysts
⚠️ Pus
⚠️ Spreading rash
⚠️ Fever
⚠️ Swelling
⚠️ Severe eczema or psoriasis flare
⚠️ Scalp bleeding
⚠️ Severe scalp scaling
⚠️ Scalp open wounds
⚠️ Sudden patchy hair loss
⚠️ Nail lifting
⚠️ Thick yellow or green nails
⚠️ Painful nails
⚠️ Diabetic foot concerns
⚠️ Deep cracks or wounds on feet
⚠️ Allergic reaction symptoms
Adilsons Beauty can guide on cosmetic body, hair, and nail care.
But some concerns need professional help first.
Once the concern is safe and calm, then a gentle routine can be built around it.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚠️ Common Body Care mistakes
Try to avoid:
❌ Treating body care as only body lotion
❌ Scrubbing body dark spots aggressively
❌ Expecting body lotion to remove tan quickly
❌ Using active body wash daily without moisturizing
❌ Skipping SPF on exposed arms, neck, hands, and feet
❌ Using foot peeling masks on cracked feet
❌ Applying conditioner heavily to oily scalp
❌ Using hair oil on scalp when scalp is already oily
❌ Using hair treatment once and expecting permanent repair
❌ Treating hair fall as only cosmetic
❌ Ignoring severe scalp symptoms
❌ Using nail products on infected-looking nails
❌ Buying too many body products without finishing current ones
❌ Expecting instant transformation
❌ Using one product for every area
❌ Confusing hair makeup with treatment
❌ Using styling products and not cleansing properly
❌ Forgetting hands and feet until they become uncomfortable
Good body care is not about doing everything.
It is about doing the right thing for the right area.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧭 How to choose from the Body Care Collection
Ask yourself:
🧼 Is this for shower freshness?
Choose body cleanser.
🧴 Is body skin dry or rough?
Choose body moisturizer.
✨ Is body tone uneven-looking?
Choose brightening-support body lotion plus SPF on exposed areas.
🌿 Is the body blemish-prone?
Choose gentle or suitable active body cleanser, and avoid harsh scrubbing.
🖐️ Are hands dry?
Choose hand cream.
🦶 Are heels rough?
Choose foot cream or urea-style foot care if skin is intact.
🧴 Is the scalp oily or sweaty?
Choose shampoo based on scalp need.
💇‍♀️ Are the hair lengths dry or frizzy?
Choose conditioner, treatment, oil, or essence.
🎀 Do you want styling support?
Choose hair styling product.
🎨 Do you want temporary hair colour or creative finish?
Choose hair makeup.
💅 Is the goal nail appearance?
Choose nail care.
⚠️ Is there pain, infection-looking skin, sudden hair loss, severe scalp issue, or nail disease signs?
Seek proper advice first.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 Simple Adilsons Beauty Body Care rule:
Choose by area first.
Then choose by concern.
For body skin, use body cleanser and moisturizer.
For body brightening support, use gentle products and SPF on exposed areas.
For hands, use hand cream consistently.
For feet, use foot cream at night and avoid peeling masks on broken skin.
For scalp, choose shampoo by scalp need.
For hair lengths, use conditioner and treatment.
For frizz or shine, use hair oil or essence carefully.
For styling, use styling products and cleanse buildup properly.
For hair makeup, remember it is cosmetic, not treatment.
For nails, keep expectations cosmetic and safe.
The best Body Care routine is not the biggest one.
It is the one that matches the correct area, supports comfort, avoids harsh claims, and helps you stay consistent.

cards.body:
🧴 Body care is skincare too.
But it is not only body lotion.
At Adilsons Beauty, we see Body Care as head-to-toe routine support.
That means care for:
✅ Body skin
✅ Hands
✅ Feet
✅ Scalp
✅ Hair lengths
✅ Hair styling
✅ Hair colour / hair makeup
✅ Nails
But because this collection is wide, the first question should not be:
“What body care product should I buy?”
The better question is:
👉 Which area are we helping?
Body skin?
Hands?
Feet?
Scalp?
Hair lengths?
Hair styling?
Nails?
Once the area is clear, choosing the right product becomes easier.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌿 What is Body Care?
Body Care is skincare beyond the face.
Your body also deals with:
☀️ Sun exposure
🌧️ Humidity
💦 Sweat
🧴 Sunscreen
👕 Friction from clothing
❄️ Air-conditioning
🧼 Frequent showers
🧴 Dryness
🦶 Rough feet
🖐️ Dry hands
💇‍♀️ Hair frizz
🌴 Mauritius heat
🏖️ Beach and outdoor lifestyle
So body care is not luxury.
It is routine care.
It helps the body, hair, hands, feet, and nails feel cleaner, softer, fresher, smoother-looking, and more comfortable.
But it should not be overpromised.
Body products should not be sold as medical treatment.
Hair products should not be sold as hair-loss cures.
Nail products should not be sold as fungal treatments.
Foot products should not replace medical care for painful, infected-looking, cracked, or diabetic foot concerns.
The simple rule is:
👉 Use Body Care for comfort, freshness, softness, appearance support, and routine consistency — not miracle transformation.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧼 BODY CLEANSER
Body cleanser is for shower cleansing.
This includes body wash, shower gel, soothing body cleanser, brightening-support body wash, acne-prone body cleanser, or exfoliating-style body cleanser.
Use body cleanser for:
✅ Daily shower freshness
✅ Sweat
✅ Body sunscreen removal
✅ Humid-weather cleansing
✅ Back and chest cleansing
✅ Body odour freshness
✅ Skin that feels sticky after heat
✅ Skin that feels heavy after outdoor days
In Mauritius, body cleanser matters because we deal with heat, sweat, sunscreen, dust, humidity, and frequent showers.
But body cleanser should still be gentle enough for regular use.
A body wash should leave the skin feeling clean — not painfully tight.
If the body cleanser has acids, exfoliating ingredients, or acne-prone support positioning, use it carefully.
Do not scrub inflamed body pimples.
Do not use strong active body wash aggressively every day from the start.
Do not skip moisturizer if the skin feels dry after.
Fresh is good.
Stripped is not.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧴 BODY MOISTURIZER
Body moisturizer is the step after showering.
This includes body lotion, body cream, body milk, body gel, brightening-support lotion, soothing body moisturizer, or richer body cream.
Use body moisturizer for:
✅ Dry body skin
✅ Rough elbows
✅ Rough knees
✅ Dry legs
✅ Dry arms
✅ AC dryness
✅ After-shower softness
✅ Body glow routines
✅ More comfortable body skin
✅ More even-looking body tone support
Many people moisturize the face but forget the body.
But the body also gets dry.
The body also gets rough.
The body also needs routine care.
A simple body routine:
1️⃣ Shower with body cleanser
2️⃣ Pat skin dry, but do not over-dry
3️⃣ Apply body moisturizer while skin is still slightly damp
4️⃣ Use richer cream at night if needed
5️⃣ Use SPF on exposed areas during the day
Body moisturizer should help skin feel softer, smoother, and more comfortable.
But do not expect body lotion to permanently whiten skin.
Do not promise tan removal.
Do not scrub dark knees, elbows, neck, or body marks aggressively.
A safer promise is:
✨ Supports softer-feeling body skin
✨ Supports smoother-looking body skin
✨ Supports more even-looking body tone
✨ Supports hydrated and comfortable body skin
That is honest and useful.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ BODY BRIGHTENING SUPPORT
If your goal is body brightening, the answer is not harsh scrubbing.
The safer routine is:
🧼 Gentle body cleanser
🧴 Brightening-support body lotion
☀️ SPF on exposed areas
⏳ Patience
🚫 No aggressive friction
Body skin can take time.
Dark knees, elbows, body marks, neck unevenness, arm marks, or sun-exposed areas usually do not change overnight.
Also, if sun exposure continues without SPF, body brightening routines become weaker.
So the safer body brightening rule is:
👉 Support gently. Moisturize consistently. Protect exposed areas from sun.
Do not chase unsafe whitening.
Do not rub the skin raw.
Do not expect instant transformation.
Healthy-looking, more even-looking body skin takes time.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌿 BODY BLEMISH-PRONE ROUTINES
Body blemishes can happen on the back, chest, shoulders, arms, or other areas.
This can be linked with:
💦 Sweat
🧴 Sunscreen
👕 Tight clothing
🏃 Gym or sports
🌴 Heat and humidity
🧼 Product buildup
🛏️ Friction
🧴 Heavy body products
A body cleanser may support acne-prone body routines.
But be careful with claims.
A body wash should not be sold as an acne cure.
A safer routine:
1️⃣ Cleanse gently in the shower
2️⃣ Use active body cleanser only if suitable
3️⃣ Do not scrub inflamed pimples
4️⃣ Moisturize if skin feels dry
5️⃣ Wear breathable clothing where possible
6️⃣ Seek proper advice if acne is painful, cystic, infected-looking, or scarring
Do not punish body skin.
Support it.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🖐️ HAND CARE
Hands are used all day.
They deal with:
🧼 Handwashing
🧴 Sanitizer
🧽 Cleaning
❄️ Air-conditioning
☀️ Sun exposure
💦 Water
🧴 Dryness around fingers
🌿 Dry cuticle area
Hand cream is simple but useful.
Use hand cream:
✅ After washing hands
✅ Before bed
✅ When hands feel dry
✅ Around cuticles
✅ After sanitizer if skin feels tight
✅ During AC exposure
✅ When hands look dry or rough
Hand care does not need to be complicated.
A hand cream helps hands feel softer and more comfortable.
But if hands are cracked, bleeding, swollen, infected-looking, or painful, skincare may not be enough.
Take the safer path and seek proper advice.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🦶 FOOT CARE
Feet are often ignored until they become uncomfortable.
In Mauritius, foot care matters because of:
🩴 Sandals
🚶 Walking
☀️ Heat
💦 Sweat
🦶 Dry heels
🏖️ Outdoor lifestyle
👟 Shoes and friction
🧼 Frequent washing
Foot care can include foot cream, foot treatment, urea foot cream, heel-care products, and foot peeling masks.
Use foot cream for:
✅ Rough-feeling heels
✅ Dry feet
✅ Sandal-season care
✅ Night foot routine
✅ Feet that feel uncomfortable
✅ Dry-looking soles
A simple foot routine:
1️⃣ Wash feet
2️⃣ Dry properly
3️⃣ Apply foot cream at night
4️⃣ Use socks if comfortable
5️⃣ Repeat consistently
Urea-style foot cream can be useful for rough-feeling heels if the skin is not broken.
Foot peeling masks can be useful for rough feet, but only when feet are intact.
Do not use foot peeling masks on:
❌ Cracked feet
❌ Bleeding feet
❌ Painful areas
❌ Open wounds
❌ Infected-looking skin
❌ Diabetic foot concerns without professional advice
Also, do not peel skin by force.
Let the process happen according to product instructions.
Foot care should support comfort.
Not create injury.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💇‍♀️ HAIR CARE STARTS WITH THE SCALP
Hair care is not one product.
A good hair routine separates:
🧠 Scalp
💇‍♀️ Hair lengths
💧 Dry ends
🌫️ Frizz
✨ Shine
🎀 Styling
🎨 Hair makeup
This is important because shampoo, conditioner, treatment, oil, essence, styling product, and hair makeup all have different jobs.
The simple rule:
👉 Shampoo is mainly for the scalp.
👉 Conditioner is mainly for lengths and ends.
👉 Treatment is deeper support.
👉 Hair oil and essence are finishing or targeted steps.
👉 Styling products shape the look.
👉 Hair makeup is cosmetic, not treatment.
Do not treat every hair concern with one product.
Scalp and hair lengths need different care.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧴 SHAMPOO
Shampoo cleans the scalp.
Not just the hair.
It can help with:
✅ Oily scalp
✅ Sweaty scalp
✅ Product buildup
✅ Scalp freshness
✅ Humid-weather scalp care
✅ Hair wash routine
✅ Post-gym cleansing
✅ Styling-product removal
In Mauritius humidity, many people feel the scalp gets oily or heavy faster.
So shampoo should be chosen based on scalp need.
Ask:
👉 Is the scalp oily?
👉 Is the scalp dry-feeling?
👉 Is there buildup?
👉 Is the scalp sweaty often?
👉 Is the hair damaged-looking but scalp oily?
👉 Is the person using styling products?
Be careful with claims.
Shampoo should not be presented as curing hair loss, psoriasis, infection, seborrheic dermatitis, or alopecia.
Safer wording:
✅ Supports scalp freshness
✅ Helps hair feel cleaner
✅ Supports stronger-looking hair
✅ Suitable for oily-scalp routines
✅ Supports scalp-care routines
If there is severe scalp pain, bleeding, pus, severe scaling, infected-looking areas, or intense irritation, professional advice is safer.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧴 CONDITIONER
Conditioner softens the hair lengths and ends.
It is usually not meant to be applied heavily on an oily scalp.
Use conditioner for:
✅ Dry ends
✅ Frizz
✅ Tangles
✅ Rough-feeling hair
✅ Long hair
✅ Post-shampoo softness
✅ Chemically treated hair
✅ Hair that feels hard to comb
A simple hair-wash routine:
1️⃣ Shampoo the scalp
2️⃣ Rinse
3️⃣ Apply conditioner to lengths and ends
4️⃣ Avoid heavy application on oily scalp
5️⃣ Rinse
6️⃣ Use leave-on oil or essence if needed
Shampoo cleans.
Conditioner softens.
If your scalp gets oily fast, do not overload it with conditioner.
Focus on the hair lengths.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌙 HAIR TREATMENT
Hair treatment is a deeper-care step.
This can include hair masks, treatment packs, protein-style treatments, repair-feel masks, scalp treatments, or intensive rinse-off care.
Use hair treatment for:
✅ Dry hair
✅ Damaged-looking hair
✅ Rough-feeling hair
✅ Frizzy hair
✅ Bleached hair
✅ Heat-styled hair
✅ Chemically treated hair
✅ Hair that lacks softness
✅ Hair that tangles easily
A hair treatment can help hair feel:
✨ Softer
✨ Smoother
✨ Shinier
✨ More manageable
✨ Less rough-feeling
✨ Easier to comb
But do not overpromise.
Hair treatment does not permanently repair destroyed hair structure.
If ends are severely damaged, trimming may still be needed.
A treatment can improve feel, slip, shine, and manageability.
But it cannot undo everything instantly.
A simple rule:
👉 Use hair treatment weekly or as needed for hair that feels dry, rough, or damaged-looking.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🫒 HAIR OIL & ESSENCE
Hair oil and essence are usually finishing or targeted steps.
They can help with:
✅ Frizz
✅ Shine
✅ Dry ends
✅ Smoother-looking hair
✅ Softer hair feel
✅ Post-wash finishing
✅ Flyaways
✅ Hair that looks dull
Use a small amount.
Start with less.
Apply mainly to lengths and ends.
Be careful using hair oil on the scalp if the scalp is already oily.
Too much oil can make fine hair flat.
Too much oil on oily scalp can make the scalp feel heavier.
Hair oil is not for every scalp.
Hair oil is usually best where dryness or frizz appears.
A simple rule:
👉 Use oil or essence where the hair needs shine, softness, or frizz support — not everywhere automatically.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎀 HAIR STYLING
Hair styling products are for the final look.
They can support:
✅ Sleek hair
✅ Frizz control
✅ Curl definition
✅ Hold
✅ Flyaway control
✅ Volume
✅ Heat-style finishing
✅ Event styling
But styling products can build up.
Especially in humidity.
If the hair or scalp feels heavy, sticky, itchy-feeling, or coated, cleansing may need attention.
A styling product is not scalp treatment.
It helps the hair look the way you want.
But it should be washed out properly.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎨 HAIR MAKEUP
Hair makeup is temporary cosmetic hair colour, touch-up, or decorative hair product.
Use hair makeup for:
✅ Temporary colour
✅ Event looks
✅ Creative styling
✅ Quick hair expression
✅ Fun cosmetic finish
But hair makeup is not hair treatment.
It does not repair hair.
It does not treat scalp conditions.
It should not be used on irritated, broken, painful, or infected-looking scalp.
Patch test if needed.
Use according to instructions.
Remove properly.
Hair makeup is for appearance.
Not medical scalp care.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💅 NAIL CARE
Nail care supports nail appearance and grooming.
It may help with:
✅ Clean-looking nails
✅ Cosmetic finish
✅ Nail grooming
✅ Nail maintenance
✅ Hand and foot beauty routines
✅ Polished appearance
But nail care should not be sold as medical treatment.
Do not use cosmetic nail products to claim treatment for:
❌ Nail fungus
❌ Nail infection
❌ Nail lifting
❌ Pus
❌ Pain
❌ Swelling
❌ Thick yellow or green nails
❌ Strange spreading colour changes
If the nail is painful, infected-looking, lifting, or changing colour strangely, professional advice is safer.
A cosmetic nail product supports appearance.
It does not replace proper care for medical-looking nail concerns.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌴 Body Care in Mauritius
Body Care should be adapted to our local reality.
In Mauritius, the body deals with:
☀️ Sun
🌧️ Humidity
💦 Sweat
🧴 Sunscreen
❄️ Air-conditioning
🏖️ Beach/outdoor lifestyle
🩴 Sandals
🧼 Frequent showers
👕 Friction from clothing
💇‍♀️ Frizz from humidity
🧴 Oily scalp
🦶 Dry heels
🖐️ Dry hands from washing
So the product choice should be practical.
For body skin:
Use lighter lotion or gel if heavy creams feel sticky.
Use richer cream at night if skin is dry.
Use SPF on exposed areas if working on body tone.
For scalp:
Choose shampoo by scalp need, not just hair length.
A person can have oily scalp and dry ends.
For hair lengths:
Use conditioner, treatment, oil, or essence where the hair feels dry or frizzy.
For feet:
Use foot cream at night.
Do not wait until heels are painful.
For hands:
Use hand cream after washing or sanitizer.
For nails:
Keep claims cosmetic and safe.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧭 Simple Body Care routine
If you want a simple body routine, start here:
🚿 Shower
Use body cleanser.
🧴 Moisturize
Apply body lotion or cream after showering.
🖐️ Hands
Use hand cream after washing hands.
🦶 Feet
Use foot cream at night if heels feel rough.
☀️ Exposed areas
Use SPF on arms, neck, feet, hands, or other exposed areas when needed.
Simple.
Consistent.
Not harsh.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ Body brightening-support routine
If your goal is brighter-looking or more even-looking body skin:
1️⃣ Use gentle body cleanser
2️⃣ Use brightening-support body lotion
3️⃣ Moisturize consistently
4️⃣ Use SPF on exposed areas
5️⃣ Avoid harsh scrubbing
6️⃣ Be patient
Do not chase unsafe whitening.
Do not expect body marks to disappear overnight.
Do not scrub dark areas aggressively.
The goal is healthier-looking, smoother-looking, more even-looking body skin over time.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌿 Body blemish-prone routine
If the back, chest, or shoulders are blemish-prone:
1️⃣ Cleanse gently
2️⃣ Use active body cleanser only if suitable
3️⃣ Do not scrub inflamed pimples
4️⃣ Shower after heavy sweat when possible
5️⃣ Avoid very tight friction-heavy clothing when possible
6️⃣ Moisturize if skin feels dry
7️⃣ Seek professional advice if painful, cystic, infected-looking, or scarring
Do not treat body blemishes by attacking the skin.
Gentle consistency is safer.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💇‍♀️ Simple hair routine
A simple hair routine:
1️⃣ Shampoo the scalp
2️⃣ Condition the lengths and ends
3️⃣ Use hair treatment weekly if hair feels dry or damaged-looking
4️⃣ Use hair oil or essence on ends if needed
5️⃣ Use styling product only when needed
6️⃣ Cleanse properly to remove buildup
Do not put every product on the scalp.
Do not shampoo the ends aggressively.
Do not overload fine hair with oil.
Do not expect one hair mask to permanently repair everything.
Hair care is routine support.
Not instant reconstruction.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🖐️🦶 Hand and foot routine
Hands and feet need small consistent steps.
For hands:
🖐️ Use hand cream after washing
🖐️ Use before bed
🖐️ Apply around dry areas
🖐️ Avoid harsh products if skin is cracked
For feet:
🦶 Use foot cream at night
🦶 Use urea-style cream for rough-feeling heels if skin is intact
🦶 Use foot peeling mask only as directed
🦶 Avoid peeling masks on cracked, painful, bleeding, or infected-looking feet
This is practical skincare.
Not luxury.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚠️ When to avoid cosmetic-only advice
Sometimes skincare is not enough.
Seek proper guidance if there is:
⚠️ Severe body acne
⚠️ Painful cysts
⚠️ Pus
⚠️ Spreading rash
⚠️ Fever
⚠️ Swelling
⚠️ Severe eczema or psoriasis flare
⚠️ Scalp bleeding
⚠️ Severe scalp scaling
⚠️ Scalp open wounds
⚠️ Sudden patchy hair loss
⚠️ Nail lifting
⚠️ Thick yellow or green nails
⚠️ Painful nails
⚠️ Diabetic foot concerns
⚠️ Deep cracks or wounds on feet
⚠️ Allergic reaction symptoms
Adilsons Beauty can guide on cosmetic body, hair, and nail care.
But some concerns need professional help first.
Once the concern is safe and calm, then a gentle routine can be built around it.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚠️ Common Body Care mistakes
Try to avoid:
❌ Treating body care as only body lotion
❌ Scrubbing body dark spots aggressively
❌ Expecting body lotion to remove tan quickly
❌ Using active body wash daily without moisturizing
❌ Skipping SPF on exposed arms, neck, hands, and feet
❌ Using foot peeling masks on cracked feet
❌ Applying conditioner heavily to oily scalp
❌ Using hair oil on scalp when scalp is already oily
❌ Using hair treatment once and expecting permanent repair
❌ Treating hair fall as only cosmetic
❌ Ignoring severe scalp symptoms
❌ Using nail products on infected-looking nails
❌ Buying too many body products without finishing current ones
❌ Expecting instant transformation
❌ Using one product for every area
❌ Confusing hair makeup with treatment
❌ Using styling products and not cleansing properly
❌ Forgetting hands and feet until they become uncomfortable
Good body care is not about doing everything.
It is about doing the right thing for the right area.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧭 How to choose from the Body Care Collection
Ask yourself:
🧼 Is this for shower freshness?
Choose body cleanser.
🧴 Is body skin dry or rough?
Choose body moisturizer.
✨ Is body tone uneven-looking?
Choose brightening-support body lotion plus SPF on exposed areas.
🌿 Is the body blemish-prone?
Choose gentle or suitable active body cleanser, and avoid harsh scrubbing.
🖐️ Are hands dry?
Choose hand cream.
🦶 Are heels rough?
Choose foot cream or urea-style foot care if skin is intact.
🧴 Is the scalp oily or sweaty?
Choose shampoo based on scalp need.
💇‍♀️ Are the hair lengths dry or frizzy?
Choose conditioner, treatment, oil, or essence.
🎀 Do you want styling support?
Choose hair styling product.
🎨 Do you want temporary hair colour or creative finish?
Choose hair makeup.
💅 Is the goal nail appearance?
Choose nail care.
⚠️ Is there pain, infection-looking skin, sudden hair loss, severe scalp issue, or nail disease signs?
Seek proper advice first.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 Simple Adilsons Beauty Body Care rule:
Choose by area first.
Then choose by concern.
For body skin, use body cleanser and moisturizer.
For body brightening support, use gentle products and SPF on exposed areas.
For hands, use hand cream consistently.
For feet, use foot cream at night and avoid peeling masks on broken skin.
For scalp, choose shampoo by scalp need.
For hair lengths, use conditioner and treatment.
For frizz or shine, use hair oil or essence carefully.
For styling, use styling products and cleanse buildup properly.
For hair makeup, remember it is cosmetic, not treatment.
For nails, keep expectations cosmetic and safe.
The best Body Care routine is not the biggest one.
It is the one that matches the correct area, supports comfort, avoids harsh claims, and helps you stay consistent.

🧴 Body care is skincare too.
But it is not only body lotion.
At Adilsons Beauty, we see Body Care as head-to-toe routine support.
That means care for:
✅ Body skin
✅ Hands
✅ Feet
✅ Scalp
✅ Hair lengths
✅ Hair styling
✅ Hair colour / hair makeup
✅ Nails
But because this collection is wide, the first question should not be:
“What body care product should I buy?”
The better question is:
👉 Which area are we helping?
Body skin?
Hands?
Feet?
Scalp?
Hair lengths?
Hair styling?
Nails?
Once the area is clear, choosing the right product becomes easier.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌿 What is Body Care?
Body Care is skincare beyond the face.
Your body also deals with:
☀️ Sun exposure
🌧️ Humidity
💦 Sweat
🧴 Sunscreen
👕 Friction from clothing
❄️ Air-conditioning
🧼 Frequent showers
🧴 Dryness
🦶 Rough feet
🖐️ Dry hands
💇‍♀️ Hair frizz
🌴 Mauritius heat
🏖️ Beach and outdoor lifestyle
So body care is not luxury.
It is routine care.
It helps the body, hair, hands, feet, and nails feel cleaner, softer, fresher, smoother-looking, and more comfortable.
But it should not be overpromised.
Body products should not be sold as medical treatment.
Hair products should not be sold as hair-loss cures.
Nail products should not be sold as fungal treatments.
Foot products should not replace medical care for painful, infected-looking, cracked, or diabetic foot concerns.
The simple rule is:
👉 Use Body Care for comfort, freshness, softness, appearance support, and routine consistency — not miracle transformation.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧼 BODY CLEANSER
Body cleanser is for shower cleansing.
This includes body wash, shower gel, soothing body cleanser, brightening-support body wash, acne-prone body cleanser, or exfoliating-style body cleanser.
Use body cleanser for:
✅ Daily shower freshness
✅ Sweat
✅ Body sunscreen removal
✅ Humid-weather cleansing
✅ Back and chest cleansing
✅ Body odour freshness
✅ Skin that feels sticky after heat
✅ Skin that feels heavy after outdoor days
In Mauritius, body cleanser matters because we deal with heat, sweat, sunscreen, dust, humidity, and frequent showers.
But body cleanser should still be gentle enough for regular use.
A body wash should leave the skin feeling clean — not painfully tight.
If the body cleanser has acids, exfoliating ingredients, or acne-prone support positioning, use it carefully.
Do not scrub inflamed body pimples.
Do not use strong active body wash aggressively every day from the start.
Do not skip moisturizer if the skin feels dry after.
Fresh is good.
Stripped is not.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧴 BODY MOISTURIZER
Body moisturizer is the step after showering.
This includes body lotion, body cream, body milk, body gel, brightening-support lotion, soothing body moisturizer, or richer body cream.
Use body moisturizer for:
✅ Dry body skin
✅ Rough elbows
✅ Rough knees
✅ Dry legs
✅ Dry arms
✅ AC dryness
✅ After-shower softness
✅ Body glow routines
✅ More comfortable body skin
✅ More even-looking body tone support
Many people moisturize the face but forget the body.
But the body also gets dry.
The body also gets rough.
The body also needs routine care.
A simple body routine:
1️⃣ Shower with body cleanser
2️⃣ Pat skin dry, but do not over-dry
3️⃣ Apply body moisturizer while skin is still slightly damp
4️⃣ Use richer cream at night if needed
5️⃣ Use SPF on exposed areas during the day
Body moisturizer should help skin feel softer, smoother, and more comfortable.
But do not expect body lotion to permanently whiten skin.
Do not promise tan removal.
Do not scrub dark knees, elbows, neck, or body marks aggressively.
A safer promise is:
✨ Supports softer-feeling body skin
✨ Supports smoother-looking body skin
✨ Supports more even-looking body tone
✨ Supports hydrated and comfortable body skin
That is honest and useful.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ BODY BRIGHTENING SUPPORT
If your goal is body brightening, the answer is not harsh scrubbing.
The safer routine is:
🧼 Gentle body cleanser
🧴 Brightening-support body lotion
☀️ SPF on exposed areas
⏳ Patience
🚫 No aggressive friction
Body skin can take time.
Dark knees, elbows, body marks, neck unevenness, arm marks, or sun-exposed areas usually do not change overnight.
Also, if sun exposure continues without SPF, body brightening routines become weaker.
So the safer body brightening rule is:
👉 Support gently. Moisturize consistently. Protect exposed areas from sun.
Do not chase unsafe whitening.
Do not rub the skin raw.
Do not expect instant transformation.
Healthy-looking, more even-looking body skin takes time.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌿 BODY BLEMISH-PRONE ROUTINES
Body blemishes can happen on the back, chest, shoulders, arms, or other areas.
This can be linked with:
💦 Sweat
🧴 Sunscreen
👕 Tight clothing
🏃 Gym or sports
🌴 Heat and humidity
🧼 Product buildup
🛏️ Friction
🧴 Heavy body products
A body cleanser may support acne-prone body routines.
But be careful with claims.
A body wash should not be sold as an acne cure.
A safer routine:
1️⃣ Cleanse gently in the shower
2️⃣ Use active body cleanser only if suitable
3️⃣ Do not scrub inflamed pimples
4️⃣ Moisturize if skin feels dry
5️⃣ Wear breathable clothing where possible
6️⃣ Seek proper advice if acne is painful, cystic, infected-looking, or scarring
Do not punish body skin.
Support it.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🖐️ HAND CARE
Hands are used all day.
They deal with:
🧼 Handwashing
🧴 Sanitizer
🧽 Cleaning
❄️ Air-conditioning
☀️ Sun exposure
💦 Water
🧴 Dryness around fingers
🌿 Dry cuticle area
Hand cream is simple but useful.
Use hand cream:
✅ After washing hands
✅ Before bed
✅ When hands feel dry
✅ Around cuticles
✅ After sanitizer if skin feels tight
✅ During AC exposure
✅ When hands look dry or rough
Hand care does not need to be complicated.
A hand cream helps hands feel softer and more comfortable.
But if hands are cracked, bleeding, swollen, infected-looking, or painful, skincare may not be enough.
Take the safer path and seek proper advice.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🦶 FOOT CARE
Feet are often ignored until they become uncomfortable.
In Mauritius, foot care matters because of:
🩴 Sandals
🚶 Walking
☀️ Heat
💦 Sweat
🦶 Dry heels
🏖️ Outdoor lifestyle
👟 Shoes and friction
🧼 Frequent washing
Foot care can include foot cream, foot treatment, urea foot cream, heel-care products, and foot peeling masks.
Use foot cream for:
✅ Rough-feeling heels
✅ Dry feet
✅ Sandal-season care
✅ Night foot routine
✅ Feet that feel uncomfortable
✅ Dry-looking soles
A simple foot routine:
1️⃣ Wash feet
2️⃣ Dry properly
3️⃣ Apply foot cream at night
4️⃣ Use socks if comfortable
5️⃣ Repeat consistently
Urea-style foot cream can be useful for rough-feeling heels if the skin is not broken.
Foot peeling masks can be useful for rough feet, but only when feet are intact.
Do not use foot peeling masks on:
❌ Cracked feet
❌ Bleeding feet
❌ Painful areas
❌ Open wounds
❌ Infected-looking skin
❌ Diabetic foot concerns without professional advice
Also, do not peel skin by force.
Let the process happen according to product instructions.
Foot care should support comfort.
Not create injury.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💇‍♀️ HAIR CARE STARTS WITH THE SCALP
Hair care is not one product.
A good hair routine separates:
🧠 Scalp
💇‍♀️ Hair lengths
💧 Dry ends
🌫️ Frizz
✨ Shine
🎀 Styling
🎨 Hair makeup
This is important because shampoo, conditioner, treatment, oil, essence, styling product, and hair makeup all have different jobs.
The simple rule:
👉 Shampoo is mainly for the scalp.
👉 Conditioner is mainly for lengths and ends.
👉 Treatment is deeper support.
👉 Hair oil and essence are finishing or targeted steps.
👉 Styling products shape the look.
👉 Hair makeup is cosmetic, not treatment.
Do not treat every hair concern with one product.
Scalp and hair lengths need different care.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧴 SHAMPOO
Shampoo cleans the scalp.
Not just the hair.
It can help with:
✅ Oily scalp
✅ Sweaty scalp
✅ Product buildup
✅ Scalp freshness
✅ Humid-weather scalp care
✅ Hair wash routine
✅ Post-gym cleansing
✅ Styling-product removal
In Mauritius humidity, many people feel the scalp gets oily or heavy faster.
So shampoo should be chosen based on scalp need.
Ask:
👉 Is the scalp oily?
👉 Is the scalp dry-feeling?
👉 Is there buildup?
👉 Is the scalp sweaty often?
👉 Is the hair damaged-looking but scalp oily?
👉 Is the person using styling products?
Be careful with claims.
Shampoo should not be presented as curing hair loss, psoriasis, infection, seborrheic dermatitis, or alopecia.
Safer wording:
✅ Supports scalp freshness
✅ Helps hair feel cleaner
✅ Supports stronger-looking hair
✅ Suitable for oily-scalp routines
✅ Supports scalp-care routines
If there is severe scalp pain, bleeding, pus, severe scaling, infected-looking areas, or intense irritation, professional advice is safer.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧴 CONDITIONER
Conditioner softens the hair lengths and ends.
It is usually not meant to be applied heavily on an oily scalp.
Use conditioner for:
✅ Dry ends
✅ Frizz
✅ Tangles
✅ Rough-feeling hair
✅ Long hair
✅ Post-shampoo softness
✅ Chemically treated hair
✅ Hair that feels hard to comb
A simple hair-wash routine:
1️⃣ Shampoo the scalp
2️⃣ Rinse
3️⃣ Apply conditioner to lengths and ends
4️⃣ Avoid heavy application on oily scalp
5️⃣ Rinse
6️⃣ Use leave-on oil or essence if needed
Shampoo cleans.
Conditioner softens.
If your scalp gets oily fast, do not overload it with conditioner.
Focus on the hair lengths.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌙 HAIR TREATMENT
Hair treatment is a deeper-care step.
This can include hair masks, treatment packs, protein-style treatments, repair-feel masks, scalp treatments, or intensive rinse-off care.
Use hair treatment for:
✅ Dry hair
✅ Damaged-looking hair
✅ Rough-feeling hair
✅ Frizzy hair
✅ Bleached hair
✅ Heat-styled hair
✅ Chemically treated hair
✅ Hair that lacks softness
✅ Hair that tangles easily
A hair treatment can help hair feel:
✨ Softer
✨ Smoother
✨ Shinier
✨ More manageable
✨ Less rough-feeling
✨ Easier to comb
But do not overpromise.
Hair treatment does not permanently repair destroyed hair structure.
If ends are severely damaged, trimming may still be needed.
A treatment can improve feel, slip, shine, and manageability.
But it cannot undo everything instantly.
A simple rule:
👉 Use hair treatment weekly or as needed for hair that feels dry, rough, or damaged-looking.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🫒 HAIR OIL & ESSENCE
Hair oil and essence are usually finishing or targeted steps.
They can help with:
✅ Frizz
✅ Shine
✅ Dry ends
✅ Smoother-looking hair
✅ Softer hair feel
✅ Post-wash finishing
✅ Flyaways
✅ Hair that looks dull
Use a small amount.
Start with less.
Apply mainly to lengths and ends.
Be careful using hair oil on the scalp if the scalp is already oily.
Too much oil can make fine hair flat.
Too much oil on oily scalp can make the scalp feel heavier.
Hair oil is not for every scalp.
Hair oil is usually best where dryness or frizz appears.
A simple rule:
👉 Use oil or essence where the hair needs shine, softness, or frizz support — not everywhere automatically.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎀 HAIR STYLING
Hair styling products are for the final look.
They can support:
✅ Sleek hair
✅ Frizz control
✅ Curl definition
✅ Hold
✅ Flyaway control
✅ Volume
✅ Heat-style finishing
✅ Event styling
But styling products can build up.
Especially in humidity.
If the hair or scalp feels heavy, sticky, itchy-feeling, or coated, cleansing may need attention.
A styling product is not scalp treatment.
It helps the hair look the way you want.
But it should be washed out properly.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎨 HAIR MAKEUP
Hair makeup is temporary cosmetic hair colour, touch-up, or decorative hair product.
Use hair makeup for:
✅ Temporary colour
✅ Event looks
✅ Creative styling
✅ Quick hair expression
✅ Fun cosmetic finish
But hair makeup is not hair treatment.
It does not repair hair.
It does not treat scalp conditions.
It should not be used on irritated, broken, painful, or infected-looking scalp.
Patch test if needed.
Use according to instructions.
Remove properly.
Hair makeup is for appearance.
Not medical scalp care.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💅 NAIL CARE
Nail care supports nail appearance and grooming.
It may help with:
✅ Clean-looking nails
✅ Cosmetic finish
✅ Nail grooming
✅ Nail maintenance
✅ Hand and foot beauty routines
✅ Polished appearance
But nail care should not be sold as medical treatment.
Do not use cosmetic nail products to claim treatment for:
❌ Nail fungus
❌ Nail infection
❌ Nail lifting
❌ Pus
❌ Pain
❌ Swelling
❌ Thick yellow or green nails
❌ Strange spreading colour changes
If the nail is painful, infected-looking, lifting, or changing colour strangely, professional advice is safer.
A cosmetic nail product supports appearance.
It does not replace proper care for medical-looking nail concerns.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌴 Body Care in Mauritius
Body Care should be adapted to our local reality.
In Mauritius, the body deals with:
☀️ Sun
🌧️ Humidity
💦 Sweat
🧴 Sunscreen
❄️ Air-conditioning
🏖️ Beach/outdoor lifestyle
🩴 Sandals
🧼 Frequent showers
👕 Friction from clothing
💇‍♀️ Frizz from humidity
🧴 Oily scalp
🦶 Dry heels
🖐️ Dry hands from washing
So the product choice should be practical.
For body skin:
Use lighter lotion or gel if heavy creams feel sticky.
Use richer cream at night if skin is dry.
Use SPF on exposed areas if working on body tone.
For scalp:
Choose shampoo by scalp need, not just hair length.
A person can have oily scalp and dry ends.
For hair lengths:
Use conditioner, treatment, oil, or essence where the hair feels dry or frizzy.
For feet:
Use foot cream at night.
Do not wait until heels are painful.
For hands:
Use hand cream after washing or sanitizer.
For nails:
Keep claims cosmetic and safe.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧭 Simple Body Care routine
If you want a simple body routine, start here:
🚿 Shower
Use body cleanser.
🧴 Moisturize
Apply body lotion or cream after showering.
🖐️ Hands
Use hand cream after washing hands.
🦶 Feet
Use foot cream at night if heels feel rough.
☀️ Exposed areas
Use SPF on arms, neck, feet, hands, or other exposed areas when needed.
Simple.
Consistent.
Not harsh.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ Body brightening-support routine
If your goal is brighter-looking or more even-looking body skin:
1️⃣ Use gentle body cleanser
2️⃣ Use brightening-support body lotion
3️⃣ Moisturize consistently
4️⃣ Use SPF on exposed areas
5️⃣ Avoid harsh scrubbing
6️⃣ Be patient
Do not chase unsafe whitening.
Do not expect body marks to disappear overnight.
Do not scrub dark areas aggressively.
The goal is healthier-looking, smoother-looking, more even-looking body skin over time.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌿 Body blemish-prone routine
If the back, chest, or shoulders are blemish-prone:
1️⃣ Cleanse gently
2️⃣ Use active body cleanser only if suitable
3️⃣ Do not scrub inflamed pimples
4️⃣ Shower after heavy sweat when possible
5️⃣ Avoid very tight friction-heavy clothing when possible
6️⃣ Moisturize if skin feels dry
7️⃣ Seek professional advice if painful, cystic, infected-looking, or scarring
Do not treat body blemishes by attacking the skin.
Gentle consistency is safer.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💇‍♀️ Simple hair routine
A simple hair routine:
1️⃣ Shampoo the scalp
2️⃣ Condition the lengths and ends
3️⃣ Use hair treatment weekly if hair feels dry or damaged-looking
4️⃣ Use hair oil or essence on ends if needed
5️⃣ Use styling product only when needed
6️⃣ Cleanse properly to remove buildup
Do not put every product on the scalp.
Do not shampoo the ends aggressively.
Do not overload fine hair with oil.
Do not expect one hair mask to permanently repair everything.
Hair care is routine support.
Not instant reconstruction.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🖐️🦶 Hand and foot routine
Hands and feet need small consistent steps.
For hands:
🖐️ Use hand cream after washing
🖐️ Use before bed
🖐️ Apply around dry areas
🖐️ Avoid harsh products if skin is cracked
For feet:
🦶 Use foot cream at night
🦶 Use urea-style cream for rough-feeling heels if skin is intact
🦶 Use foot peeling mask only as directed
🦶 Avoid peeling masks on cracked, painful, bleeding, or infected-looking feet
This is practical skincare.
Not luxury.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚠️ When to avoid cosmetic-only advice
Sometimes skincare is not enough.
Seek proper guidance if there is:
⚠️ Severe body acne
⚠️ Painful cysts
⚠️ Pus
⚠️ Spreading rash
⚠️ Fever
⚠️ Swelling
⚠️ Severe eczema or psoriasis flare
⚠️ Scalp bleeding
⚠️ Severe scalp scaling
⚠️ Scalp open wounds
⚠️ Sudden patchy hair loss
⚠️ Nail lifting
⚠️ Thick yellow or green nails
⚠️ Painful nails
⚠️ Diabetic foot concerns
⚠️ Deep cracks or wounds on feet
⚠️ Allergic reaction symptoms
Adilsons Beauty can guide on cosmetic body, hair, and nail care.
But some concerns need professional help first.
Once the concern is safe and calm, then a gentle routine can be built around it.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚠️ Common Body Care mistakes
Try to avoid:
❌ Treating body care as only body lotion
❌ Scrubbing body dark spots aggressively
❌ Expecting body lotion to remove tan quickly
❌ Using active body wash daily without moisturizing
❌ Skipping SPF on exposed arms, neck, hands, and feet
❌ Using foot peeling masks on cracked feet
❌ Applying conditioner heavily to oily scalp
❌ Using hair oil on scalp when scalp is already oily
❌ Using hair treatment once and expecting permanent repair
❌ Treating hair fall as only cosmetic
❌ Ignoring severe scalp symptoms
❌ Using nail products on infected-looking nails
❌ Buying too many body products without finishing current ones
❌ Expecting instant transformation
❌ Using one product for every area
❌ Confusing hair makeup with treatment
❌ Using styling products and not cleansing properly
❌ Forgetting hands and feet until they become uncomfortable
Good body care is not about doing everything.
It is about doing the right thing for the right area.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧭 How to choose from the Body Care Collection
Ask yourself:
🧼 Is this for shower freshness?
Choose body cleanser.
🧴 Is body skin dry or rough?
Choose body moisturizer.
✨ Is body tone uneven-looking?
Choose brightening-support body lotion plus SPF on exposed areas.
🌿 Is the body blemish-prone?
Choose gentle or suitable active body cleanser, and avoid harsh scrubbing.
🖐️ Are hands dry?
Choose hand cream.
🦶 Are heels rough?
Choose foot cream or urea-style foot care if skin is intact.
🧴 Is the scalp oily or sweaty?
Choose shampoo based on scalp need.
💇‍♀️ Are the hair lengths dry or frizzy?
Choose conditioner, treatment, oil, or essence.
🎀 Do you want styling support?
Choose hair styling product.
🎨 Do you want temporary hair colour or creative finish?
Choose hair makeup.
💅 Is the goal nail appearance?
Choose nail care.
⚠️ Is there pain, infection-looking skin, sudden hair loss, severe scalp issue, or nail disease signs?
Seek proper advice first.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 Simple Adilsons Beauty Body Care rule:
Choose by area first.
Then choose by concern.
For body skin, use body cleanser and moisturizer.
For body brightening support, use gentle products and SPF on exposed areas.
For hands, use hand cream consistently.
For feet, use foot cream at night and avoid peeling masks on broken skin.
For scalp, choose shampoo by scalp need.
For hair lengths, use conditioner and treatment.
For frizz or shine, use hair oil or essence carefully.
For styling, use styling products and cleanse buildup properly.
For hair makeup, remember it is cosmetic, not treatment.
For nails, keep expectations cosmetic and safe.
The best Body Care routine is not the biggest one.
It is the one that matches the correct area, supports comfort, avoids harsh claims, and helps you stay consistent.

✅ Hands

✅ Hair styling

✅ Nails
But because this collection is wide, the first question should not be:
“What body care product should I buy?”
The better question is:
👉 Which area are we helping?
Body skin?
Hands?
Feet?
Scalp?
Hair lengths?
Hair styling?
Nails?
Once the area is clear, choosing the right product becomes easier.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Body Care is skincare beyond the face.
Your body also deals with:
☀️ Sun exposure
🌧️ Humidity
💦 Sweat
🧴 Sunscreen
👕 Friction from clothing
❄️ Air-conditioning
🧼 Frequent showers
🧴 Dryness
🦶 Rough feet
🖐️ Dry hands
💇‍♀️ Hair frizz
🌴 Mauritius heat
🏖️ Beach and outdoor lifestyle
So body care is not luxury.
It is routine care.
It helps the body, hair, hands, feet, and nails feel cleaner, softer, fresher, smoother-looking, and more comfortable.
But it should not be overpromised.
Body products should not be sold as medical treatment.
Hair products should not be sold as hair-loss cures.
Nail products should not be sold as fungal treatments.
Foot products should not replace medical care for painful, infected-looking, cracked, or diabetic foot concerns.
The simple rule is:
👉 Use Body Care for comfort, freshness, softness, appearance support, and routine consistency — not miracle transformation.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧼 BODY CLEANSER
Body cleanser is for shower cleansing.
This includes body wash, shower gel, soothing body cleanser, brightening-support body wash, acne-prone body cleanser, or exfoliating-style body cleanser.
Use body cleanser for:
✅ Daily shower freshness
✅ Sweat
✅ Body sunscreen removal
✅ Humid-weather cleansing
✅ Back and chest cleansing
✅ Body odour freshness
✅ Skin that feels sticky after heat
✅ Skin that feels heavy after outdoor days
In Mauritius, body cleanser matters because we deal with heat, sweat, sunscreen, dust, humidity, and frequent showers.
But body cleanser should still be gentle enough for regular use.
A body wash should leave the skin feeling clean — not painfully tight.
If the body cleanser has acids, exfoliating ingredients, or acne-prone support positioning, use it carefully.
Do not scrub inflamed body pimples.
Do not use strong active body wash aggressively every day from the start.
Do not skip moisturizer if the skin feels dry after.
Fresh is good.
Stripped is not.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧴 BODY MOISTURIZER
Body moisturizer is the step after showering.
This includes body lotion, body cream, body milk, body gel, brightening-support lotion, soothing body moisturizer, or richer body cream.
Use body moisturizer for:
✅ Dry body skin
✅ Rough elbows
✅ Rough knees
✅ Dry legs
✅ Dry arms
✅ AC dryness
✅ After-shower softness
✅ Body glow routines
✅ More comfortable body skin
✅ More even-looking body tone support
Many people moisturize the face but forget the body.
But the body also gets dry.
The body also gets rough.
The body also needs routine care.
A simple body routine:
1️⃣ Shower with body cleanser
2️⃣ Pat skin dry, but do not over-dry
3️⃣ Apply body moisturizer while skin is still slightly damp
4️⃣ Use richer cream at night if needed
5️⃣ Use SPF on exposed areas during the day
Body moisturizer should help skin feel softer, smoother, and more comfortable.
But do not expect body lotion to permanently whiten skin.
Do not promise tan removal.
Do not scrub dark knees, elbows, neck, or body marks aggressively.
A safer promise is:
✨ Supports softer-feeling body skin
✨ Supports smoother-looking body skin
✨ Supports more even-looking body tone
✨ Supports hydrated and comfortable body skin
That is honest and useful.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ BODY BRIGHTENING SUPPORT
If your goal is body brightening, the answer is not harsh scrubbing.
The safer routine is:
🧼 Gentle body cleanser
🧴 Brightening-support body lotion
☀️ SPF on exposed areas
⏳ Patience
🚫 No aggressive friction
Body skin can take time.
Dark knees, elbows, body marks, neck unevenness, arm marks, or sun-exposed areas usually do not change overnight.
Also, if sun exposure continues without SPF, body brightening routines become weaker.
So the safer body brightening rule is:
👉 Support gently. Moisturize consistently. Protect exposed areas from sun.
Do not chase unsafe whitening.
Do not rub the skin raw.
Do not expect instant transformation.
Healthy-looking, more even-looking body skin takes time.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌿 BODY BLEMISH-PRONE ROUTINES
Body blemishes can happen on the back, chest, shoulders, arms, or other areas.
This can be linked with:
💦 Sweat
🧴 Sunscreen
👕 Tight clothing
🏃 Gym or sports
🌴 Heat and humidity
🧼 Product buildup
🛏️ Friction
🧴 Heavy body products
A body cleanser may support acne-prone body routines.
But be careful with claims.
A body wash should not be sold as an acne cure.
A safer routine:
1️⃣ Cleanse gently in the shower
2️⃣ Use active body cleanser only if suitable
3️⃣ Do not scrub inflamed pimples
4️⃣ Moisturize if skin feels dry
5️⃣ Wear breathable clothing where possible
6️⃣ Seek proper advice if acne is painful, cystic, infected-looking, or scarring
Do not punish body skin.
Support it.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🖐️ HAND CARE
Hands are used all day.
They deal with:
🧼 Handwashing
🧴 Sanitizer
🧽 Cleaning
❄️ Air-conditioning
☀️ Sun exposure
💦 Water
🧴 Dryness around fingers
🌿 Dry cuticle area
Hand cream is simple but useful.
Use hand cream:
✅ After washing hands
✅ Before bed
✅ When hands feel dry
✅ Around cuticles
✅ After sanitizer if skin feels tight
✅ During AC exposure
✅ When hands look dry or rough
Hand care does not need to be complicated.
A hand cream helps hands feel softer and more comfortable.
But if hands are cracked, bleeding, swollen, infected-looking, or painful, skincare may not be enough.
Take the safer path and seek proper advice.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🦶 FOOT CARE
Feet are often ignored until they become uncomfortable.
In Mauritius, foot care matters because of:
🩴 Sandals
🚶 Walking
☀️ Heat
💦 Sweat
🦶 Dry heels
🏖️ Outdoor lifestyle
👟 Shoes and friction
🧼 Frequent washing
Foot care can include foot cream, foot treatment, urea foot cream, heel-care products, and foot peeling masks.
Use foot cream for:
✅ Rough-feeling heels
✅ Dry feet
✅ Sandal-season care
✅ Night foot routine
✅ Feet that feel uncomfortable
✅ Dry-looking soles
A simple foot routine:
1️⃣ Wash feet
2️⃣ Dry properly
3️⃣ Apply foot cream at night
4️⃣ Use socks if comfortable
5️⃣ Repeat consistently
Urea-style foot cream can be useful for rough-feeling heels if the skin is not broken.
Foot peeling masks can be useful for rough feet, but only when feet are intact.
Do not use foot peeling masks on:
❌ Cracked feet
❌ Bleeding feet
❌ Painful areas
❌ Open wounds
❌ Infected-looking skin
❌ Diabetic foot concerns without professional advice
Also, do not peel skin by force.
Let the process happen according to product instructions.
Foot care should support comfort.
Not create injury.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💇‍♀️ HAIR CARE STARTS WITH THE SCALP
Hair care is not one product.
A good hair routine separates:
🧠 Scalp
💇‍♀️ Hair lengths
💧 Dry ends
🌫️ Frizz
✨ Shine
🎀 Styling
🎨 Hair makeup
This is important because shampoo, conditioner, treatment, oil, essence, styling product, and hair makeup all have different jobs.
The simple rule:
👉 Shampoo is mainly for the scalp.
👉 Conditioner is mainly for lengths and ends.
👉 Treatment is deeper support.
👉 Hair oil and essence are finishing or targeted steps.
👉 Styling products shape the look.
👉 Hair makeup is cosmetic, not treatment.
Do not treat every hair concern with one product.
Scalp and hair lengths need different care.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧴 SHAMPOO
Shampoo cleans the scalp.
Not just the hair.
It can help with:
✅ Oily scalp
✅ Sweaty scalp
✅ Product buildup
✅ Scalp freshness
✅ Humid-weather scalp care
✅ Hair wash routine
✅ Post-gym cleansing
✅ Styling-product removal
In Mauritius humidity, many people feel the scalp gets oily or heavy faster.
So shampoo should be chosen based on scalp need.
Ask:
👉 Is the scalp oily?
👉 Is the scalp dry-feeling?
👉 Is there buildup?
👉 Is the scalp sweaty often?
👉 Is the hair damaged-looking but scalp oily?
👉 Is the person using styling products?
Be careful with claims.
Shampoo should not be presented as curing hair loss, psoriasis, infection, seborrheic dermatitis, or alopecia.
Safer wording:
✅ Supports scalp freshness
✅ Helps hair feel cleaner
✅ Supports stronger-looking hair
✅ Suitable for oily-scalp routines
✅ Supports scalp-care routines
If there is severe scalp pain, bleeding, pus, severe scaling, infected-looking areas, or intense irritation, professional advice is safer.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧴 CONDITIONER
Conditioner softens the hair lengths and ends.
It is usually not meant to be applied heavily on an oily scalp.
Use conditioner for:
✅ Dry ends
✅ Frizz
✅ Tangles
✅ Rough-feeling hair
✅ Long hair
✅ Post-shampoo softness
✅ Chemically treated hair
✅ Hair that feels hard to comb
A simple hair-wash routine:
1️⃣ Shampoo the scalp
2️⃣ Rinse
3️⃣ Apply conditioner to lengths and ends
4️⃣ Avoid heavy application on oily scalp
5️⃣ Rinse
6️⃣ Use leave-on oil or essence if needed
Shampoo cleans.
Conditioner softens.
If your scalp gets oily fast, do not overload it with conditioner.
Focus on the hair lengths.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌙 HAIR TREATMENT
Hair treatment is a deeper-care step.
This can include hair masks, treatment packs, protein-style treatments, repair-feel masks, scalp treatments, or intensive rinse-off care.
Use hair treatment for:
✅ Dry hair
✅ Damaged-looking hair
✅ Rough-feeling hair
✅ Frizzy hair
✅ Bleached hair
✅ Heat-styled hair
✅ Chemically treated hair
✅ Hair that lacks softness
✅ Hair that tangles easily
A hair treatment can help hair feel:
✨ Softer
✨ Smoother
✨ Shinier
✨ More manageable
✨ Less rough-feeling
✨ Easier to comb
But do not overpromise.
Hair treatment does not permanently repair destroyed hair structure.
If ends are severely damaged, trimming may still be needed.
A treatment can improve feel, slip, shine, and manageability.
But it cannot undo everything instantly.
A simple rule:
👉 Use hair treatment weekly or as needed for hair that feels dry, rough, or damaged-looking.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🫒 HAIR OIL & ESSENCE
Hair oil and essence are usually finishing or targeted steps.
They can help with:
✅ Frizz
✅ Shine
✅ Dry ends
✅ Smoother-looking hair
✅ Softer hair feel
✅ Post-wash finishing
✅ Flyaways
✅ Hair that looks dull
Use a small amount.
Start with less.
Apply mainly to lengths and ends.
Be careful using hair oil on the scalp if the scalp is already oily.
Too much oil can make fine hair flat.
Too much oil on oily scalp can make the scalp feel heavier.
Hair oil is not for every scalp.
Hair oil is usually best where dryness or frizz appears.
A simple rule:
👉 Use oil or essence where the hair needs shine, softness, or frizz support — not everywhere automatically.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎀 HAIR STYLING
Hair styling products are for the final look.
They can support:
✅ Sleek hair
✅ Frizz control
✅ Curl definition
✅ Hold
✅ Flyaway control
✅ Volume
✅ Heat-style finishing
✅ Event styling
But styling products can build up.
Especially in humidity.
If the hair or scalp feels heavy, sticky, itchy-feeling, or coated, cleansing may need attention.
A styling product is not scalp treatment.
It helps the hair look the way you want.
But it should be washed out properly.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎨 HAIR MAKEUP
Hair makeup is temporary cosmetic hair colour, touch-up, or decorative hair product.
Use hair makeup for:
✅ Temporary colour
✅ Event looks
✅ Creative styling
✅ Quick hair expression
✅ Fun cosmetic finish
But hair makeup is not hair treatment.
It does not repair hair.
It does not treat scalp conditions.
It should not be used on irritated, broken, painful, or infected-looking scalp.
Patch test if needed.
Use according to instructions.
Remove properly.
Hair makeup is for appearance.
Not medical scalp care.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💅 NAIL CARE
Nail care supports nail appearance and grooming.
It may help with:
✅ Clean-looking nails
✅ Cosmetic finish
✅ Nail grooming
✅ Nail maintenance
✅ Hand and foot beauty routines
✅ Polished appearance
But nail care should not be sold as medical treatment.
Do not use cosmetic nail products to claim treatment for:
❌ Nail fungus
❌ Nail infection
❌ Nail lifting
❌ Pus
❌ Pain
❌ Swelling
❌ Thick yellow or green nails
❌ Strange spreading colour changes
If the nail is painful, infected-looking, lifting, or changing colour strangely, professional advice is safer.
A cosmetic nail product supports appearance.
It does not replace proper care for medical-looking nail concerns.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌴 Body Care in Mauritius
Body Care should be adapted to our local reality.
In Mauritius, the body deals with:
☀️ Sun
🌧️ Humidity
💦 Sweat
🧴 Sunscreen
❄️ Air-conditioning
🏖️ Beach/outdoor lifestyle
🩴 Sandals
🧼 Frequent showers
👕 Friction from clothing
💇‍♀️ Frizz from humidity
🧴 Oily scalp
🦶 Dry heels
🖐️ Dry hands from washing
So the product choice should be practical.
For body skin:
Use lighter lotion or gel if heavy creams feel sticky.
Use richer cream at night if skin is dry.
Use SPF on exposed areas if working on body tone.
For scalp:
Choose shampoo by scalp need, not just hair length.
A person can have oily scalp and dry ends.
For hair lengths:
Use conditioner, treatment, oil, or essence where the hair feels dry or frizzy.
For feet:
Use foot cream at night.
Do not wait until heels are painful.
For hands:
Use hand cream after washing or sanitizer.
For nails:
Keep claims cosmetic and safe.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧭 Simple Body Care routine
If you want a simple body routine, start here:
🚿 Shower
Use body cleanser.
🧴 Moisturize
Apply body lotion or cream after showering.
🖐️ Hands
Use hand cream after washing hands.
🦶 Feet
Use foot cream at night if heels feel rough.
☀️ Exposed areas
Use SPF on arms, neck, feet, hands, or other exposed areas when needed.
Simple.
Consistent.
Not harsh.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ Body brightening-support routine
If your goal is brighter-looking or more even-looking body skin:
1️⃣ Use gentle body cleanser
2️⃣ Use brightening-support body lotion
3️⃣ Moisturize consistently
4️⃣ Use SPF on exposed areas
5️⃣ Avoid harsh scrubbing
6️⃣ Be patient
Do not chase unsafe whitening.
Do not expect body marks to disappear overnight.
Do not scrub dark areas aggressively.
The goal is healthier-looking, smoother-looking, more even-looking body skin over time.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌿 Body blemish-prone routine
If the back, chest, or shoulders are blemish-prone:
1️⃣ Cleanse gently
2️⃣ Use active body cleanser only if suitable
3️⃣ Do not scrub inflamed pimples
4️⃣ Shower after heavy sweat when possible
5️⃣ Avoid very tight friction-heavy clothing when possible
6️⃣ Moisturize if skin feels dry
7️⃣ Seek professional advice if painful, cystic, infected-looking, or scarring
Do not treat body blemishes by attacking the skin.
Gentle consistency is safer.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💇‍♀️ Simple hair routine
A simple hair routine:
1️⃣ Shampoo the scalp
2️⃣ Condition the lengths and ends
3️⃣ Use hair treatment weekly if hair feels dry or damaged-looking
4️⃣ Use hair oil or essence on ends if needed
5️⃣ Use styling product only when needed
6️⃣ Cleanse properly to remove buildup
Do not put every product on the scalp.
Do not shampoo the ends aggressively.
Do not overload fine hair with oil.
Do not expect one hair mask to permanently repair everything.
Hair care is routine support.
Not instant reconstruction.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🖐️🦶 Hand and foot routine
Hands and feet need small consistent steps.
For hands:
🖐️ Use hand cream after washing
🖐️ Use before bed
🖐️ Apply around dry areas
🖐️ Avoid harsh products if skin is cracked
For feet:
🦶 Use foot cream at night
🦶 Use urea-style cream for rough-feeling heels if skin is intact
🦶 Use foot peeling mask only as directed
🦶 Avoid peeling masks on cracked, painful, bleeding, or infected-looking feet
This is practical skincare.
Not luxury.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚠️ When to avoid cosmetic-only advice
Sometimes skincare is not enough.
Seek proper guidance if there is:
⚠️ Severe body acne
⚠️ Painful cysts
⚠️ Pus
⚠️ Spreading rash
⚠️ Fever
⚠️ Swelling
⚠️ Severe eczema or psoriasis flare
⚠️ Scalp bleeding
⚠️ Severe scalp scaling
⚠️ Scalp open wounds
⚠️ Sudden patchy hair loss
⚠️ Nail lifting
⚠️ Thick yellow or green nails
⚠️ Painful nails
⚠️ Diabetic foot concerns
⚠️ Deep cracks or wounds on feet
⚠️ Allergic reaction symptoms
Adilsons Beauty can guide on cosmetic body, hair, and nail care.
But some concerns need professional help first.
Once the concern is safe and calm, then a gentle routine can be built around it.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚠️ Common Body Care mistakes
Try to avoid:
❌ Treating body care as only body lotion
❌ Scrubbing body dark spots aggressively
❌ Expecting body lotion to remove tan quickly
❌ Using active body wash daily without moisturizing
❌ Skipping SPF on exposed arms, neck, hands, and feet
❌ Using foot peeling masks on cracked feet
❌ Applying conditioner heavily to oily scalp
❌ Using hair oil on scalp when scalp is already oily
❌ Using hair treatment once and expecting permanent repair
❌ Treating hair fall as only cosmetic
❌ Ignoring severe scalp symptoms
❌ Using nail products on infected-looking nails
❌ Buying too many body products without finishing current ones
❌ Expecting instant transformation
❌ Using one product for every area
❌ Confusing hair makeup with treatment
❌ Using styling products and not cleansing properly
❌ Forgetting hands and feet until they become uncomfortable
Good body care is not about doing everything.
It is about doing the right thing for the right area.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧭 How to choose from the Body Care Collection
Ask yourself:
🧼 Is this for shower freshness?
Choose body cleanser.
🧴 Is body skin dry or rough?
Choose body moisturizer.
✨ Is body tone uneven-looking?
Choose brightening-support body lotion plus SPF on exposed areas.
🌿 Is the body blemish-prone?
Choose gentle or suitable active body cleanser, and avoid harsh scrubbing.
🖐️ Are hands dry?
Choose hand cream.
🦶 Are heels rough?
Choose foot cream or urea-style foot care if skin is intact.
🧴 Is the scalp oily or sweaty?
Choose shampoo based on scalp need.
💇‍♀️ Are the hair lengths dry or frizzy?
Choose conditioner, treatment, oil, or essence.
🎀 Do you want styling support?
Choose hair styling product.
🎨 Do you want temporary hair colour or creative finish?
Choose hair makeup.
💅 Is the goal nail appearance?
Choose nail care.
⚠️ Is there pain, infection-looking skin, sudden hair loss, severe scalp issue, or nail disease signs?
Seek proper advice first.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 Simple Adilsons Beauty Body Care rule:
Choose by area first.
Then choose by concern.
For body skin, use body cleanser and moisturizer.
For body brightening support, use gentle products and SPF on exposed areas.
For hands, use hand cream consistently.
For feet, use foot cream at night and avoid peeling masks on broken skin.
For scalp, choose shampoo by scalp need.
For hair lengths, use conditioner and treatment.
For frizz or shine, use hair oil or essence carefully.
For styling, use styling products and cleanse buildup properly.
For hair makeup, remember it is cosmetic, not treatment.
For nails, keep expectations cosmetic and safe.
The best Body Care routine is not the biggest one.
It is the one that matches the correct area, supports comfort, avoids harsh claims, and helps you stay consistent.

body.text:
I spent over $347.67 last month in podiatrist visits and my heel cracks were STILL the same.
That's not even counting the Vaseline. The gel socks.
The foot masks I ordered off Amazon.

None of it worked.

I'm 61. I've dealt with dry and cracky feet for a decade. 

The cracks would often get better with my routine but by afternoon I was right back to limping around my own kitchen. 

Standing at the stove hurt. Standing at work hurt. 

I stopped wearing anything that didn’t have cushion. 

Podiatrist visits were my last resort. 
My podiatrist kept using the word "fissures." 
She said, “23% of heel fissures become an entry point for infection later on. Bacteria. Fungal.”
She said it plainly, no drama.

That scared me so much.

But I went through every type of socks like they were paper towels.

Then one day, the lady who does my feet at the nail salon told me something the podiatrist never mentioned. 

“You have to get yourself a urea foot stick.” 
It’s a 60% urea stick. Like a deodorant stick, she said, but for your heels.

I'll be honest, I was skeptical. 

I'd tried "urea creams" before. The 20%, even 30%. 
They were messy and smelt like glue.

She told me this one was 60% urea. 
I didn't even know that concentration existed.

So I ordered a urea stick from my favorite skincare website that night.

It came quickly. It’s a cute little roll-on stick that you apply to your feet.
